description: Unique identifier of the EC2 instance, e.g. i-0ec2used123.
The EC2 instance type/size, e.g. t3.medium, m5.large. Determines the On-Demand hourly rate.
AWS region the instance runs in, e.g. us-east-1.
Number of hours the instance was in a running state during the billing period.
The published On-Demand hourly price for this InstanceType in this Region, in USD.
How the instance is billed: On-Demand, Reserved, or Spot. Affects the effective hourly rate.
HoursRunning multiplied by the effective hourly rate for the given PurchaseOption, in USD.
